criteria.requirement: Add opt-in task_lists conversion in actual convert_li. A task checkbox is exclusively the first direct non-whitespace/non-comment content node, an input whose type is case-insensitive checkbox; checked attribute presence means checked regardless of attribute text. Emit [x]/[ ] after existing unordered or ordered bullet, retaining empty tasks, nested list ownership and multiline indentation. Default conversion remains unchanged. Never infer parent tasks from descendant labels/lists or later inputs, and never interpret other input types as checkboxes.
